scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: deno lint backend/supabase/functions backend/supabase/tests && deno fmt --check backend/supabase/functions backend/supabase/tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:backend:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/run-local-supabase-command.mjs npm run test:e2e --workspace frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
